summary: Agency: The Graceful Ordinary QA3 public recheck found the stable URL reachable but still not sell-ready; fresh evidence and MC-compatible blocker payload were prepared locally.

metadata.human_summary: I rechecked The Graceful Ordinary public preview. The stable URL now opens, which is good, but it is still not ready for Ethan to sell: mobile navigation and reserve flow are weak, the hero/logo are hard to read, the menu has mobile clipping, and the previously flagged proof/recognition language is still unsafe unless verified or removed.
metadata.technical_summary: Planner protected auth is unavailable in this runtime, so I used read-only Supabase diagnosis and local artifacts only. I verified route status for the stable public URL and PR preview, captured fresh desktop/mobile screenshots with headless Chrome, scraped public route text, wrote QA3 recheck notes, updated checklist.md/checklist.json, and prepared a canonical MC build writeback payload. No raw Supabase mutation was performed.
metadata.work_started_state: The Graceful Ordinary was in_progress at qa_round_3 with an older blocker around preview auth/stale public content.
metadata.work_completed_state: Fresh QA3 evidence confirms the stable public URL is reachable but still blocked for sellability/truth-safety; local checklist and MC-compatible payload now reflect the current blocker.
